about: Cline hooks: one PowerShell script per hook, named after it, in ~/Documents/Cline/Hooks. Payload fields are nested per hook (userPromptSubmit.prompt, taskComplete.taskMetadata.result).

files.~/Documents/Cline/Hooks/UserPromptSubmit:
# SanskritLearning read-aloud hook (adapters/hooks/adapter.cjs). Installed and removed by: node scripts/agent-hooks.cjs install|uninstall cline
# node reads the payload from this script's stdin directly.
{{command:UserPromptSubmit}}
exit 0
files.~/Documents/Cline/Hooks/TaskComplete.ps1:

{{command:TaskComplete}}

files.~/Documents/Cline/Hooks/TaskCancel.ps1:

install.after: Cline hooks are on by default (setting hooksEnabled).
